newsitem.title: USA: NH Public Service says 43,000 still without power.
newsitem.headline: NH Public Service says 43,000 still without power.

text.p: New Hampshire Public Service, a subsidiary of Northeast Utilities, reported up to 43,000 customers remained without power on Monday, after two storms dumped more than two feet of snow in parts of New England.

"The storm has caused major damage to our electric distribution centers around the state," said Ian Wilson, a spokesman for the utlity. Crews from New York, Canada and Pennsylvania have been called in to help restore power.
Some of the outtages were expected to last until Thursday, Wilson said.
